meta.title: Viking vengeance — Kingshot 777
meta.description: TL;DR guide to Kingshot Viking Vengeance: emptying your castle, hero placement, HQ defense, and when not to heal.

tldr.heading: TL;DR
items: Empty your castle. Trade your troops and spare heroes out to other members. Leftover troops of your own cut the score of everyone supporting you.
Top 3 heroes in the Guard Station, strongest first. Everything else goes out on exchange.
Do not heal mid-event. Healing pulls your troops home and tanks your supporters' scores. Only heal before the second failure ends it, or in the recall between stages 9 and 10.
Stages 10 and 20 are HQ. Shield infantry above tier 8 plus a little cavalry — follow whatever your leadership specifies.
Reinforce with infantry and cavalry. Vikings hit infantry first, cavalry second, archers last — leave archers home if your march is full.
Be online for stages 7, 14 and 17. Those only hit online players and score the highest.
Reinforce empty, uncrowded cities. Points split by share of kills, so avoid doubling up with a whale.
Pair up with similar power. Groups of two or six, positioned close together, so support arrives fast within the 1-minute gap.

maximizing.heading: Maximizing your points
items: Send infantry and cavalry. Vikings engage infantry first, then cavalry, then archers — so infantry and cavalry get into the fight early and take the kills. If your march can't hold everything, leave the archers at home.
Reinforce online players. Waves 7, 14 and 17 only attack members who are online. March slots spent on offline allies are wasted, and offline players usually haven't cleared their city anyway.

Pick empty, uncrowded cities. The point pool is split by share of kills. Look for an ally with no troops of their own and only one or two other reinforcers. Share a city with a whale and their higher-tier troops will siphon most of the kills.

Rotate to HQ for waves 10 and 20. Those waves hit the Alliance HQ only — no cities. Once the wave 9 (or 19) battle report has finished, recall one strong march and send it to HQ, then send it back to your ally as soon as the HQ wave ends. Recall too early and you forfeit the previous wave's points.
Lead with an offensive hero. Use your Bear Hunt joiner heroes in the leader slot — Chenko, Amadeus, Yeonwoo or Amane — for extra damage and a bigger share of the kills.

tips.heading: Tips
items: Sort your exchange before it starts. A botched exchange leaves troops sitting in your castle for the whole event.
Agree positions in advance so nobody is out of support range when a wave lands.

qa.a: You score by killing Vikings attacking castles — mostly other people's. That's why an empty castle is worth more to your alliance than a defended one: supporters get the kills.

qa.q: Why does leaving troops at home hurt?
qa.a: Your own troops soak the kills that would otherwise go to your supporters. Exchange them out so your castle is genuinely empty.
About a minute normally, roughly three minutes for the HQ stages (10 and 20).

qa.q: What if I have an alt in the alliance?
qa.a: Use its troops to reinforce your main. If you're tier 10, the alt can also defend on its own for extra points.
